items.mainDefect: to_dict() returns asdict(self), which leaves queued as a raw datetime, so serializing the Celery task payload in sync_group_assignee_outbound can fail.

secondary.defect: queued = timezone.now() is evaluated only once, when the class is defined, so every instance that uses the default gets the same timestamp; it should use field(default_factory=timezone.now).

items.mainDefect: test_from_dict_empty_array says it tests an empty array, but it actually passes an empty dict, so the name does not match what the test does.

secondary.defect: The test name test_from_dict_inalid_data has a typo ('inalid' should be 'invalid').
